description: The AHE split with a larger train set: train = AHE's 80 train tasks + the 80 tasks AHE left unused (160, field train_origin), val = AHE's 20, test = AHE's 70 (both unchanged). All 250 firm-knowledge tasks; 10 difficulty blocks of 25 = 16 train, 2 val, 7 test each. Not compatible with splits.json (the 60/20/20 split).

flip.description: Train tasks (train 160) whose all-pass flips across the three Luna-high base runs: passed in exactly 1 or 2 of 3. Traces and per-task analysis: benchmarks/harvey/analysis/hv-lunahigh-train80-flip14/. Derived by make_flip_subset.py (user, 2026-11-13).
